outcome: Accuracy of perinatal and neonatal data in the Discharge Abstract Database (DAD)
cohort: The study included 2084 neonates born <33 weeks gestational age admitted to Neonatal Intensive Care Units in Winnipeg, Canada, between 2010 and 2022.
finding: Neonatal variables like gestational age and birth weight showed high accuracy in the DAD, while the accuracy of maternal and neonatal morbidities and interventions varied from very good to poor.
mod_finding: The accuracy of Caesarean section data in the DAD was very good, with a kappa value of 0.91.
